response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT t.transreg AS transreg, t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvol FROM transactionrecord t JOIN sentimentandfundamentals s ON s.transref = t.transreg GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist), grp AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(avg_short) AS dummy FROM per GROUP BY ordertypedist), typeavg AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS type_avg FROM transactionrecord t JOIN sentimentandfundamentals s ON s.transref = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist) SELECT p.transreg AS transaction_reference, p.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, p.avg_short AS avg_short_interest, p.avg_optvol AS avg_option_volume_ratio, p.avg_short * 1.0 / NULLIF(ta.type_avg, 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM per p LEFT JOIN typeavg ta ON ta.ordertypedist IS p.ordertypedist ORDER BY short_interest_ratio IS NULL, short_interest_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
